versions.content: function  Csm_KeyElementSet  [SWS_CP_CRYPTO_00005]   Std_ReturnType Csm_KeyElementSet(uint32 keyId, uint32 keyElementId, const uint8* keyPtr, uint32 keyLength); Sets a key element inside a designated key slot in volatile RAM or non-volatile HSM storage. Crypto Interface (CryIf) CryIf routes CSM jobs to specific hardware crypto drivers (HSM, SHE, TPM) or software crypto implementations.
